problem.description: Problem is why routines couldn't use it (doesn't start, not signed in, bad tools).

readOnly.description: ReadOnly tools run in dry runs; the others are writes (intercepted).

annotated.description: Annotated is whether the tool declares annotations (readOnlyHint) at all.

items.description: PluginTool is one of a plugin's tools, as a routine would see it.

needsSignIn.description:
NeedsSignIn means it couldn't be tried further without credentials
(`auth login <name>`, then `plugins check <name>`).

items.description: PluginCheck is one row of `plugins check --json`.
